cells.gaps: Mamou's digitised collection is a donor project ending in 2026, with its replication elsewhere still being studied; nothing says where its record is held, or that any commune records outside a project.
cells.note: Enabel's REVIS project digitised the census and collection of market and motorcycle-taxi taxes in one town, Mamou, in 2026 (GIN-004, GIN-005), a time-limited project whose replication is under study: a pilot. Its results in August 2026 are an advance inside the twelve months.
